column1: # QRX App Store catalog (ships with the image; never fetched from the network).
# One app per line, fields separated by TABs:
#   id  name  subtitle  category  version  archive-bytes  installed-bytes  sha256  https-url  launch  developer  license  description  [arch]
# arch: m68k (QRX OS One, the default when left out) or m68k64 (QRX OS One 64); each App Store shows only its own.
# category: Create | Work | Play | Develop. The archive is a .tar.xz holding the folder <id>/ (or its files);
# it is installed to APPS:<id> only if its SHA-256 equals the one here. launch: the file in APPS:<id> to start
# (a script with the s bit runs through Execute). Add a line with tools/armithlon/appstore/add-to-catalog.sh.
# Blender 2.79b: tools/blender/package-appstore.sh (reproducible), attached to the GitHub release
# appstore-blender-2.79b-1; until that release exists the download fails and nothing is installed.
# ThunderCat for AROS 153.8.0 (Firefox 153.8.0 source) for QRX OS One 64: tools/armithlon/spidermonkey/package-appstore.sh
# (reproducible), attached to the GitHub release appstore-thundercat-153.8.0-1.

column3: The web browser for AROS, based on Firefox
column13: ThunderCat for AROS (c) 2026 by Pascal Papara, based on Firefox 153.8: a full web browser running natively on QRX OS One 64. Tabs, address bar with suggestions, mouse, wheel and keyboard, in a window on the desktop. Gecko in one process, drawn by WebRender. More at qrx.rocks. Firefox is a trademark of the Mozilla Foundation; this is not a Mozilla product.
